nodes.label: Version-Gated External Action
nodes.rationale: An order action must remain blocked when the ABCP version differs from the version reviewed and confirmed by the customer and manager; the user must reconcile the material delta before proceeding.

nodes.label: Visible AI Employee Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Staffy should expose build, test, publish, monitor, and improve as an understandable employee lifecycle, with explicit simulation, controlled, and live states instead of technical menus or a single undifferentiated publish action.

nodes.label: Controlled Business Actions
nodes.rationale: Free-form conversation remains flexible while side effects are limited to typed actions with validation, authorization, idempotency, risk-based approval, and reconciliation.

nodes.label: Employee Not Technology Metaphor
nodes.rationale: The owner should experience Staffy as hiring, training, and safely admitting a digital employee to work, because business outcomes, duties, limits, and evidence matter more than exposure to models, prompts, pipelines, or provider choices.

nodes.label: Reliable Business Action Safety
nodes.rationale: Material actions require preparation, validation, confirmation where needed, idempotent execution, receipts, and reconciliation of unknown outcomes; ambiguous results must never be reported as success.

nodes.label: Two-Domain Platform Proof
nodes.rationale: The first release is proven only when one shared core operates both the autoparts and Montagio service pilots, followed by a third independent tenant without core changes or a client fork.

nodes.label: Staged Media Infrastructure Adoption
nodes.rationale: Pion supplies WebRTC primitives rather than SIP, PBX, transcoding, recording, and HA; Staffy should adopt Asterisk or LiveKit SIP first and replace only a measured bottleneck.

nodes.label: Narrow Vertical Wedge Decision
nodes.rationale: Horizontal voice-agent features are already crowded and commoditizing, so Staffy should validate a narrow transaction-completing vertical before building a universal platform or proprietary media engine.

nodes.label: Measurement-Gated Go Data Plane Trigger
nodes.rationale: Broader Go ownership should follow only if a controlled far-end benchmark demonstrates material latency and all-in cost improvement at matched quality and reliability under realistic PSTN and interruption workloads.

nodes.label: Owned Control Plane with Replaceable Media Edge
nodes.norm_label: owned control plane with replaceable media edge
nodes.rationale: Staffy should own tenant state, policy, actions, connectors, audit, and evaluation while buying or swapping telephony and realtime media components until measurements justify a narrower owned Go data plane.

nodes.label: Go Modular Monolith
nodes.rationale: A six-module Go monolith keeps transactions, module ownership, and pilot operations simple while a separately replaceable media edge preserves future scaling and isolation options.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Scoped Admission
nodes.rationale: Only exact, current, scoped PASS instances grant permission; missing, failed, expired, or inapplicable evidence cannot broaden a route and all applicable gates are conjunctive.
